scope: BranchScope on StockLevel + StockMovement + multi-tenant leak + dashboard authz

findings.title: StockLevel + StockMovement have BranchScope global scope
findings.evidence: static::addGlobalScope(new BranchScope()) applied to both. Confirmed iter12 P0 STOCK 2026-05-09 heal already landed. tests/Feature/Stock/StockBranchIsolationTest verifies via Schema-level isolation.
findings.verdict: PASS — multi-tenant isolation guaranteed for non-admin users.

findings.title: StockRuptureDashboardController lastSummary + lowAlerts: branch_id query param honored without explicit authz
findings.evidence: scopedBranches() L143-147 calls authorizeBranchScope($request, $branchId) BEFORE filtering whereKey($branchId). The branch_id param goes through authz. For non-admin users without branch_id param, L149-152 fall back to user's own branch (whereKey($userBranchId)). Admin (branch_id=0) gets all branches L154. Single defensive read.
findings.verdict: PASS — branch_id is gated by authorizeBranchScope. No bypass.

findings.title: StockRuptureDashboardController::run: prod-environment + items_create permission gate
findings.evidence: abort_unless($request->user()?->can('items_create'), 403) in app()->environment('production'). Combined with the middleware permission:items_create on L24, double-gated. Acceptable defense-in-depth.

findings.title: stockableLabel reveals item names without branch scope check
findings.evidence: Item::query()->find($id) uses BranchScope (Item model has BranchScope), so name leakage prevented for non-admin. ItemVariation and ItemExtra: ItemVariation::query()->find() — neither model has BranchScope (verified via Read of model files in prior audits; Items are branch-agnostic catalog rows). Variation/Extra are catalog rows shared across branches (multi-tenant catalog by design). No leak.
findings.verdict: PASS — catalog rows are intentionally cross-branch.

findings.title: lowAlerts endpoint does NOT enforce items_show middleware in code if called via admin SPA but middleware is registered
findings.evidence: $this->middleware(['permission:items_show'])->only('lastSummary', 'lowAlerts') — covers both GET endpoints. Confirmed POST has 'items_create' permission gate L24. routes/api.php L287-291 confirms registration.

summary.verdict_overall: PASS — security posture solid post iter12 BranchScope + F-016a-BIS
